token_stats.title: Token Usage
token_stats.cost_tooltip: This is an estimate made before translating. Tokens are the unit AI services measure text and cost in, roughly one Chinese character or one English word each; your provider's bill is the final word on cost.
token_stats.actual_usage_tooltip: These token counts are what the AI service reported with each answer, added up over the requests that finished.
token_stats.partial_usage_tooltip: Some answers did not report their full usage, so this only adds up what was reported and may be lower than what was used.
token_stats.calculated_cost_tooltip: Calculated from API-reported tokens and the model prices frozen when the task was created. It is not a provider invoice; DeepSeek cache hits and time-based rates can differ.
token_stats.unpriced_cost_tooltip: Some actual usage belongs to legacy tasks without frozen model prices, so a reliable total cost cannot be calculated.
token_stats.remaining_cost_tooltip: Unstarted tasks use their full estimate. Running tasks subtract incurred calculated cost. Failed and completed tasks are excluded.

tour.config_content: Configure translation parameters in the left panel, including languages, output format, segmentation mode, and output path. All settings are saved automatically and restored the next time you open the tool.
tour.lang_content: Set the source and target languages for the subtitles. Translation is available between Japanese, English, Chinese, and many other languages.
tour.output_mode_content: “Bilingual” keeps the original text and appends the translation, while “Target only” outputs only the translation.
tour.slice_content: Subtitles are split according to the selected strategy and sent to the AI for translation segment by segment. Choose standard, fine-grained, or custom character-count segmentation.
tour.output_path_content: Choose where to save translated files: a custom folder or the source subtitle file’s folder.
tour.schedule_content: Set translation to start automatically at a specific time, which is useful for batch processing overnight or during idle periods.
tour.upload_content: Drag .lrc or .srt subtitle files here, or click to select files. You can add multiple files at once.
tour.queue_content: All added translation tasks appear here. You can check progress, edit settings, retry failed tasks, or delete tasks.
tour.start_content: Click to start all pending translation tasks. When they finish, you can find the result files in the output path.

config.title: Transcription settings
config.vad_hint: Skips the parts where nobody speaks, so silence is not misheard as words.
config.window_strategy_hint: Applies to new tasks only. Retries keep the original task's selection.
config.window_pause_note: Splits at clear pauses to reduce seam duplicates, with overlapping windows as a fallback. Voice detection turns on automatically; switch to fixed windows to turn it off. Audio up to 30 seconds or over 24 hours uses fixed windows.
config.window_pause_vad_required: Splitting at pauses needs voice detection, so it is turned on. Switch to fixed windows before turning it off.
config.vad_not_ready: Install voice detection before turning this on
config.initial_prompt_hint: Used only in this page session and never persisted.
config.cue_targets_hint: Original text and timing take priority. Cues may exceed these targets when internal sentence boundaries cannot be confirmed.
config.conflict_overwrite_unavailable: The safe-overwrite component is unavailable in this app session, so automatic numbering is used instead. Transcription remains available.

tour.model_setup_content: A model is needed before the first transcription. Download one of the listed models in Local environment. If you already have a model file, you can click Import model, but it must be exactly one of the listed models.
tour.config_content: Configure the local model, compute device, output formats, and post-transcription actions in the left panel. Settings are saved automatically.
tour.model_content: Choose an installed recognition model. Larger models are usually more accurate but take more disk space and transcribe more slowly.
tour.language_content: Choose the language in the media, or leave automatic detection enabled so the model can infer it from the audio.
tour.upload_content: Drop audio or video files here, or click to select them. You can add up to 100 media files at once.
tour.queue_content: This area shows media probe results, transcription progress, generated subtitles, and retry actions for failed tasks.
tour.start_content: Once the environment, model, and media are ready, click here to start all pending tasks.

runtime_crashed.cause: The transcription program quit unexpectedly or stopped responding.
runtime_crashed.next: Try again. On Windows, if the page says the Microsoft runtime is missing, click "Fix it" first. If it still fails, restart the computer and try again.
runtime_crashed.next_cpu: Try "Retry on CPU". On Windows, if the page says the Microsoft runtime is missing, click "Fix it" first.

accelerator.cause: Graphics acceleration cannot be used right now.
accelerator.next: Reinstall graphics acceleration in Local environment or update the graphics driver, or set "Compute device" to CPU and transcribe again.
accelerator.next_cpu: Try "Retry on CPU", reinstall graphics acceleration in Local environment, or update the graphics driver.

model_missing.cause: The selected model is not installed yet.
model_missing.next: Download the model in Local environment first.

model_incompatible.cause: The model file could not be loaded.
model_incompatible.next: On Windows, make sure the Microsoft runtime is installed first (the page says so at the top when it is missing), then download the model again.

verify.cause: The downloaded file did not pass its integrity check.
verify.next: Download it again. If it still fails, change the download source under Setting → Network.

download.cause: The download did not finish, usually because the address could not be reached or the network blocked it.
download.next: Change the download source or turn on a proxy under Setting → Network, then download again.

disk.cause: There is not enough disk space.
disk.next: Free up enough space and try again.

not_allowed.cause: This resource is not on the list of resources that can be downloaded.

authorization.cause: Permission to use this file has expired.
authorization.next: Select the file again and retry.

media.cause: No audio that can be transcribed could be read from this file.
media.next: Make sure the file plays normally, or convert it to a common format such as MP4 or MP3 and try again.

no_audio.cause: This file has no audio track.

media_changed.cause: The file was changed or moved during transcription.
media_changed.next: Add the file again and transcribe it.

transcription.next: Try again. If it still fails, try another model.
transcription.next_cpu: Try again, or use "Retry on CPU".

memory.cause: The computer ran out of memory.
memory.next: Close other programs that use a lot of memory, or switch to a smaller model, and try again.

output_conflict.cause: A file with the same name already exists where it would be saved.
output_conflict.next: Choose "Add a number" under "File conflicts", or pick another output folder.

output_write.cause: The subtitle file could not be saved.
output_write.next: Make sure the output folder exists, can be written to and has enough space.

cleanup.cause: Temporary files could not be cleaned up.

artifact.cause: This subtitle file was changed, moved or deleted.
artifact.next: Look for it in its folder, or transcribe again.

preview.cause: This subtitle file is too large, or its content is not in the expected format.
preview.next: Open it from its folder instead.

limit.cause: Too many files, or too much content, at once.
limit.next: Add fewer at a time and try again.

partial.cause: The task was cancelled; subtitles exported before the cancel were kept.

page_stale.cause: The page lost its connection to local transcription.

translation_setup.cause: Subtitle translation has no usable model profile yet.
translation_setup.next: Add a profile with its key under Setting → AI Model, then choose it under "Execution profile".

duplicate.cause: This subtitle is already in the subtitle translation list, so it was not added again.
duplicate.next: Open subtitle translation to see it.

unsupported_format.cause: Subtitle translation does not support this subtitle format.
unsupported_format.next: Choose another format under "Translation format" and try again.

import_failed.cause: The subtitle could not be added to subtitle translation.
import_failed.next: Try again. If it still fails, open subtitle translation and import the subtitle file there yourself.

not_started.cause: The subtitle was added to subtitle translation, but the translation did not start by itself.
not_started.next: Open subtitle translation, check the task and start it yourself.

unknown.next: Try again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostic information below and send it to the developer.
